title: Tiny, cute tractor
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>

  <ellipse cx='50' cy='86' rx='42' ry='6' fill='#3a5a2a'/>
  <!-- rear big wheel -->
  <circle cx='68' cy='68' r='19' fill='#2c2c3a'/>
  <circle cx='68' cy='68' r='15' fill='#e8a33d'/>
  <circle cx='68' cy='68' r='13' fill='#c47f1f'/>

  <rect x='50' y='66' width='5' height='4' fill='#f7d089'/>
  <rect x='81' y='66' width='5' height='4' fill='#f7d089'/>

  <rect x='44' y='26' width='28' height='26' rx='4' fill='#e8574e'/>
  <rect x='44' y='24' width='28' height='5' rx='2' fill='#f7d089'/>
  <rect x='48' y='30' width='9' height='16' rx='2' fill='#bfe3f2'/>

  <rect x='34' y='30' width='5' height='16' rx='2' fill='#6b7280'/>
  <rect x='33' y='27' width='7' height='4' rx='2' fill='#9aa3ad'/>

  <circle cx='37' cy='23' r='3.5' fill='#d9dde3'/>
  <circle cx='41' cy='19' r='2.5' fill='#e7eaee'/>

  <circle cx='23' cy='50' r='3' fill='#ffe680'/>

  <circle cx='68' cy='68' r='2.5' fill='#8a5a12'/>
  <circle cx='26' cy='76' r='1.8' fill='#8a5a12'/>
